doc.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024

title: Marian McPartland as mentor and Piano Jazz appearances
summary: McPartland gave Rowe her apartment key, commissioned arrangements, and had her on Piano Jazz in 1990 and perhaps 1996.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: About what years was — this occurred?

“Piano Jazz” was 1990 and the other one might have been 1996. I’ve got to check my years on that but I definitely know 1990 was one of them. And so I had only been college teaching for about five years at that point. But I just remembered being pretty terrified going down to New York and finding the studio and there were the two pianos side by side and she didn’t like to do extra takes if she didn’t have to so off we went.
